# cidaas_idval_setting (Resource)

`cidaas_idval_setting` manages a cidaas ID Validator settings instance, e.g. an age verification configuration. Prevalidation, document data matching and the ID document filter are not supported by this resource and are always sent disabled. **Deletion is not supported via Terraform** - cidaas appears to authorize deleting this resource by role/group membership on a human identity rather than by OAuth scope, so a client_credentials app can create, read and update it but not delete it. Delete manually via the cidaas Admin UI, then run `terraform state rm` to drop it from state (or just remove the resource from your config and run `terraform apply -refresh-only`, since a manually-deleted setting is also detected on the next `Read` and dropped from state automatically).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cidaas_idval_setting" "age_check_de" {
  id                    = "b4ba52ae-87b3-4967-93b6-8e6ae8f39922"
  name                  = "Kaufland Marketplace Age Check DE"
  description           = "Kaufland Marketplace Age Check DE"
  mode                  = "AgeCheckEssential"
  allowed_redirect_uris = "https://account.kaufland.com https://www.kaufland.de https://kaufland.de"

  consent_config = {
    enabled = true
    consents = [{
      name      = "Consent"
      url       = "https://www.kaufland.de/i/rechtliches/datenschutz?hidebanner=true"
      mandatory = true
      localization = {
        de = "..."
        en = "..."
      }
    }]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_redirect_uris` (String) Space-separated list of URLs the end-user may be redirected to after completion
- `consent_config` (Attributes) Consent configuration shown during the ID validation process (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent_config))
- `description` (String) Description of the setting
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the ID Validator setting
- `mode` (String) ID validation mode
- `name` (String) Display name of the setting

### Optional

- `theme` (String) Theme applied to the ID Validator UI

### Read-Only

- `created_time` (String) Time the setting was created
- `updated_time` (String) Time the setting was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--consent_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consent_config`

Required:

- `consents` (Attributes List) List of consents to display to the end-user (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--consent_config--consents))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether consent collection is enabled

<a id="nestedatt--consent_config--consents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `consent_config.consents`

Required:

- `localization` (Map of String) Localized consent text keyed by language code
- `mandatory` (Boolean) Whether the consent must be accepted to continue
- `name` (String) Internal reference name of the consent
- `url` (String) Publicly accessible consent document URL

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cidaas_idval_setting.age_check_de b4ba52ae-87b3-4967-93b6-8e6ae8f39922
```
